title: Quartz-Seq2
scope: Sasagawa 2018 Quartz-Seq2 implementation: the middle Quartz-seq2 row of the supplied Illumina schematic, from single-cell sorting and barcoded RT to a sequencing-ready cDNA-derived DNA library. Original Quartz-Seq (top row) and DP-Seq (bottom row) are neighboring workflows outside the assigned target; their T7, LNA-blocking and heptamer-primer operations are not imported. The PolyA RNA icon identifies the biological target of the coupled lysis/RT block rather than a separately depicted RNA-purification preparation. The final boundary is material library DNA, with the primary paper clarifying its prospective read interface.

method_scopes.rationale: The card names Quartz-Seq2 and the image explicitly labels its middle row Quartz-seq2. The matched 2018 primary paper describes this row's distinguishing cell-barcode/UMI RT, pooling before amplification, improved TdT/poly(dT) tagging, and pool-barcoded custom library. All six local operation instances apply to this scoped implementation. The top original Quartz-Seq route, including its primer-digestion/LNA steps, and the lower DP-Seq route are excluded by the assigned card scope. The primary text also explicitly states that the selected short RT-primer design allows omission of exonuclease-I byproduct removal. No equivalence of these neighboring assays is asserted.

corrections.diagram_observation: The middle-row caption says that TdT-based WTA provides a 3.6-fold increase in polyA-tagging to UMI conversion efficiency, placing poly(A) tagging and UMI conversion in one quantitative phrase.
corrections.primary_statement: The primary Results attribute the approximately 3.6-fold result to increased amplified-cDNA amount when T55 buffer is combined with the Increment tagging/second-strand-synthesis approach; yield is used to assess improved poly(A)-tagging performance. Read-to-UMI conversion is a distinct metric, reported as 30–50%. Accordingly, the architecture implements improved cDNA tailing and second-strand synthesis without asserting a 3.6-fold increase in read-to-UMI conversion or crediting TdT alone.
